info.title: SynCloud API
info.description: The public SynCloud controller API. The dashboard, synctl and CI all use these endpoints (plan §5.1). Authenticate with the dashboard session cookie, a personal access token (Bearer), or a signed access-key request (SYN1-HMAC-SHA256, plan §7.1).

get.summary: Controller version and setup state
This API description

post.summary: Exchange the one-time setup token for the root account and sign in

201.description: Root account created; session cookie set

post.summary: Sign in to the dashboard (sets the session cookie)
End the current session

get.summary: The authenticated user
Live event stream (WebSocket upgrade). Each message is a JSON Event.
Your access keys

post.summary: Create an access key (max 2 per user). The secret is returned only once.

delete.summary: Delete one of your access keys

get.summary: Your personal access tokens

post.summary: Create a personal access token. The token is returned only once.

delete.summary: Delete one of your personal access tokens

post.summary: Register a node with a join token (used by syncloud-agent join). Returns the node's client certificate signed from its CSR.

delete.summary: Remove a node. Its certificate stops working immediately.

get.summary: Active (unexpired, unused) join tokens

post.summary: Create a join token. The token is returned only once.

Docker registry token endpoint (used by docker login/push/pull). Basic auth: access key ID + secret, or any username + personal access token.

rps.description: requests per second this task answered (from the access log)

accessKey.name: Authorization
accessKey.description: SYN1-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=<access key id>, Signature=<hex>, with X-Syn-Date and X-Syn-Content-Sha256 headers

recoveryKeySuffix.description: Last 6 characters of the recovery key printed at install (required when status.recoveryConfirmRequired)

secretAccessKey.description: Only present in the create response

token.description: Only present in the create response

csr.description: PEM certificate signing request for the node's own key

gatewayAddress.description: host:port of the agent gateway (gRPC, mTLS)

token.description: Only present in the create response

targets.description: node IDs, or ["*"] for all nodes (default)

sharedEnv.description: shared variables every service in the environment inherits
snapshot of the environment's shared variables for this revision (set by the platform; env wins)

vip.description: stable virtual IP inside the private network (§8.6)

fields.description: request lines only: method, host, path, status, duration_ms, bytes, client, upstream, service_id

pulls.description: manifest pulls recorded from registry notifications

inUseBy.description: services whose current revision runs this image

branch.description: branch to build, or a pattern such as release/* (every matching branch is built)

context.description: build context directory inside the repository

webhookPath.description: push webhook path, relative to the dashboard URL

tags.description: also build new tags matching this pattern, e.g. v* (empty: tags are ignored)

paths.description: only build commits that change a matching file ("!" excludes; * matches across directories), e.g. services/api/**

builder.description: auto: the Dockerfile, else Nixpacks, else a static site (index.html served by nginx on port 80)

refs.description: watched branches and tags with their last seen commit

branch.description: branch to build, or a pattern such as release/* (every matching branch is built)

tags.description: also build new tags matching this pattern, e.g. v* (empty: tags are ignored)

paths.description: only build commits that change a matching file ("!" excludes; * matches across directories), e.g. services/api/**

builder.description: auto: the Dockerfile, else Nixpacks, else a static site (index.html served by nginx on port 80)

status.description: skipped: no changed file matched the path filters

runId.description: the job run that executes the build; its logs are the build log

baseSha.description: the previous commit of the ref, which path filters compare with

key.description: task ID (service scope) or service name (environment scope)

charts.description: cpu (percent of one core), memory (bytes), netRx, netTx, diskRead, diskWrite (bytes/s)

priority.description: lower runs first; an image belongs to the first rule whose prefix matches

keepLast.description: keep the newest N, expire the rest (set this or olderThanDays)

olderThanDays.description: expire images created more than N days ago

inUse.description: used by a service's current or previous revision; never expired

host.description: registry host, e.g. docker.io or ghcr.io

actor.description: user email, node, build or controller

RouteTraffic.description: one routed service's traffic over the summary window

charts.description: requests (series per status class 2xx…5xx, req/s), latency (p50/p95/p99, ms), bandwidth (in/out, bytes/s) and, beyond one service, services (req/s per service)
